mapper.select: SELECT id, source_kind AS sourceKind, problem_card AS problemCard, target, status, attribution, dedup_key AS dedupKey, review_note AS reviewNote, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM improvement_proposal WHERE dedup_key = #{dedupKey}
